test.title: Green Valley Campsite — rules for guests

paragraphs.text: Check-in is from 2 pm and pitches must be cleared by 11 am on the day of departure. Quiet hours run from 10 pm to 7 am. Barbecues are permitted only on the gravel area behind the shower block.
paragraphs.label: A

paragraphs.text: Dogs are welcome but must be kept on a lead of no more than two metres. The shop sells bread and milk from 8 am. Firewood costs £6 a bag and is sold at reception until 9 pm.
paragraphs.label: B
